clause: MCP-native command tools + JSON tree read + server-side render [STU-AUT-021,STU-AUT-022]

scope.summary: Expose the full typed command contract as MCP tools (auto-generated from command inputSchemas, the SAME surface the model lanes drive per 14.16 - extends foundation MT-007 MCP scaffold to full coverage), plus a document JSON tree read (serialize a document or node subtree as a typed JSON node tree) and server-side render (render a node/selection to PNG/JPG/SVG/PDF bytes at a requested scale via the export command). Local-first, no hosted MCP endpoint dependency.
acceptance_criteria: full command contract as MCP tools; JSON tree read; server-side render; local-first
proof_targets: MCP tool exposure + JSON tree + server-render runtime tests
expected_tests: live: full command set exposed as MCP tools with generated inputSchema
live: document JSON tree read returns typed node tree; server-side render returns PNG bytes
negative: no hosted MCP endpoint required

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

target_entries: Studio / Automation / MCP command tools & rendering (model layer)

risk_if_missed: Command contract not fully MCP-exposed; models cannot drive Studio natively.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
